policies.zone_copy: ChooseFromZone copy_current, distinct card identity; physical representative selected by shared chooser, current local state only while original residence remains. Fate executes own-deck then opponent-deck stage.
policies.deaths: Friendly means controller at actual death. Printed card identity counts Ysondre deaths, including current committed death; printed Dragon/all metadata qualifies resurrection, one offer per card identity, earliest actual death material retained.
policies.ysondre: One original attributed random collectible Dragon batch, count of friendly Ysondre death records, replacement true; no current-entity reconstruction.
policies.rite: Native optional SpendResource2 branches before offers into native Dark Gift discovery or plain Undead/all discovery. Exact resource/offer timing remains local M6 policy.
policies.farm: SpendUpToResource cap8 result determines printed summon cost including0; debit occurs even if full, capacity and pre-RNG unknown checks belong to shared SummonFromPool.
policies.removal: t21 uses public legal enemy minion target qualification, choose min(2,n), original references and one removal batch. t29 removes every other physical board minion including Dormant, not locations; Dormant scope is local M6 policy.
policies.improviser: Prepare and completed successful own actual spell cast this global turn, all actual origins; two full Mage Secret pool attempts, with replacement and per-cast refresh. Existing duplicates/capacity handled by native caster, no executable-content crop.
policies.hogger: before_deal hook freezes current physical deck Legendary cards of any playable kind except original physical self, current copy material, one semantic shuffle batch. Original deck and opening hands remain native; other hooks can change the current deck before this hook.
